name: hud_ui_cycle_selector_widget_add_text_entry
description: HudUiCycleSelectorWidget::AddTextEntry grows the entry range, constructs a transition text panel, initializes text and layout, hides it, and attaches it to the owner container.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification now passes under the HudUiCycleSelectorWidget AddTextEntry source target.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x4b7fd0 grows itemCount to min(index + 1, 20), raises visibleCount to the new count, returns when index is greater than visibleCount, constructs a 0x2c0-byte HudUiTransitionTextPanel, stores it in entriesA[index], calls virtual SetTextFmt/SetPos/SetVisible, and adds it to base.owner.

Native smoke zhud_cycle_selector_text_entry_smoke verifies AddTextEntry creates an entry at index 3, applies text and offset-adjusted position, hides the entry, initializes flash defaults, and links it into the owner HudUiContainer.
tier_s_evidence: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x4b7fd0 (2026-06-16, vc5_o2_ob1_md_gx_facs) passes with zero unmasked mismatches after 32 relocation-masked bytes and 5 trimmed VC NOP bytes; BN size 299, VC5 size 304.
